categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches only src/net.cpp and functional tests; does not modify the build system, dependencies, toolchains, or CI configuration despite the Windows label.
categories.rationale: The PR addresses runtime network socket configuration rather than build or platform toolchain support.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Tagged P2P and changes incoming listen socket binding behavior in src/net.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents local port hijacking on Windows where another process running under the same user could bind to the P2P port and intercept incoming connections. The author notes that SO_REUSEADDR on Windows permits connection interception by matching security contexts unless SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE is specified.
